status: Complete exploratory annotation, awaiting owner visual review; not production rendering data

definitions.identity: Every original x/y is retained in original order. Draw only representative entries to avoid the two owner-reviewed duplicate pairs.
definitions.appearance: Four proposed types: fine-grain, bright-point, diffuse-dust, undetermined. Measurements and flags remain available when a type cannot be assigned reliably.
definitions.brightness: Mean source sRGB channel signal on 0–255 scale, not linear-light luminance, source intensity or alpha.
definitions.size: Equivalent-circle diameters of connected local contrast regions, not physical diameter. null means contrast was nonpositive.
definitions.color: observedSrgb is an image appearance estimate from unsaturated pixels, not recovered albedo. Family uses local-background-subtracted signal. near-neutral does not prove an intrinsically white grain.
definitions.colorUncertainty: Shared contours and weak peaks affected by a nearby bright point retain family undetermined; candidateFamily is only a hint. No copper/blue/white proportions are imposed.
definitions.depth: Artistic staging hypothesis only: normalized 0=far, 1=near. Not camera Z, not meters, not monocular depth recovery. plausibleRange is an authoring range, not a statistical confidence interval.
definitions.depthAssumptions: Small fine grains biased far, broad diffuse grains biased near, bounded bright points in the middle. Undefined signals use 0.5/unassigned. Color and brightness alone never determine distance.
definitions.grouping: Only U2 and U4 are merged by owner review. Other shared contours are flagged, never automatically merged.
definitions.uncertainty: Halo overlap, blur, saturation and background can be ambiguous. All depth confidence is low. Heuristic confidence labels are not calibrated probabilities.

analysis.confidencePolicy: Appearance is at most medium except the two owner-reviewed groups. Color confidence is at most medium and fallback is low. All depth confidence is low; these are ordinal heuristics, not probabilities.

depthMapping.undetermined: 0.5, band unassigned, staging range [0,1]; explicit placeholder, not an inferred distance

analysis.background: Median mean-RGB and per-channel medians in an 8–12px annulus, clipped to valid image/mask bounds.
analysis.footprints: 8-connected regions above background + fraction*contrast, clipped to a 25x25 valid patch; other peak membership is retained.
analysis.appearanceOrder: Owner review; otherwise weak/shared/clipped half-height signals -> undetermined; D50<=2.5 -> fine; contrast>=40 and D50<=8 -> bright; D50>2.5 and D20/D80>=1.4 -> diffuse; otherwise undetermined.
analysis.colorMethod: Use unsaturated 15–85% contrast shoulders within radius4, avoid pixels closer to another grain; fallback to unsaturated center. Compare red/blue difference to12% and neutral channel spread to10% after subtracting local RGB background.
analysis.neighborHaloFlag: A separately detected peak with contrast>=100 within12px is a possible contaminant, not proof of bloom or occlusion.

summary.countsAre: Counts of heuristic candidate descriptors, not validated physical-particle or palette proportions
